title: map input
description: Manage mappings in your user folder (create, list, resolve, update, delete, apply). Create accepts one mapping, a mappings list, or an absolute mappingsPath to a checked mapping file; the list is validated whole and written atomically. Optional substitutions name a shipped OODS Foundry component and React/Vue package exports with prop translations validated against its contract. Legacy Stage1 annotations remain round-trip data. draft reads a local shadcn project or built Storybook without executing code or fetching. show exposes every proposed adapter and unmatched source element. apply with draftId and explicitly accepted proposal ids validates and atomically registers the batch, installing only reviewed new adapter files.

action.description: Selects the per-action handler to invoke.

minConfidence.description: Candidates below this threshold are routed to queued instead of being applied.

reportPath.description: Filesystem path to a reconciliation_report.json artifact.

items.description: A single-create payload without action or apply; the handler checks every value against MappingEntry and returns OODS-V219 per-entry outcomes for invalid entries.

mappings.description: Create entries, each without apply. All entries are checked before one atomic write.

mappingsPath.description: Absolute path to a JSON document { mappings: [...] }, using the same entry shape.

externalSystem.description: Filter mappings to a specific external system (e.g., 'team').

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Use the previous page's nextCursor to continue. When cursor or limit is provided, pagination defaults to 100 items per page.

limit.description: Page size for pagination. Omitting both cursor and limit preserves the legacy full-list response.
